slides.content:

slides.title: The Old XHTML Way ⚠️
slides.content:
# A Brief History Lesson In older XHTML, you might see tags like `
` or ``. The slash at the end was required back then. In modern HTML5, that slash is **optional and often omitted**. Both work, but `
` is cleaner and the current standard. Don't be confused if you see the old style!

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Know Your Void Elements

A quick cheat: if an element can't logically have children (like an image can't contain text), it's probably a void element. Use MDN for a definitive list.

quizData.question: Which of the following is a void element?
quizData.explanation: <hr> is a void element (horizontal rule); it has no content and no closing tag.
